title: Allotopic Expression of ND6 Restores Vision in a Mitochondrial Disease Model.

outcomes.name: visual function
outcomes.effect_text: restored visual function in ND6P25L mice

outcomes.name: retinal cellular deficiencies and optic nerve damage
outcomes.effect_text: mitigated retinal cellular deficiencies and optic nerve damage

outcomes.name: retinal and optic nerve expression / systemic toxicity
outcomes.effect_text: robust, sustained expression within the retina and optic nerve without apparent systemic toxicity
